summary: Iter116 end-to-end verification PASSED. Backend regression: 569 passed, 17 skipped (new tests/test_iter116_levels_and_rules.py contributes 13 passed + 1 skipped). New tests cover PUT /api/positions/{id}/rules (persist, clear→null, 422 on be_r=5/partial_tp_pct=10/ai_review_minutes=7/trail_atr_mult=4, 404 unknown/invalid id, bot settings untouched, 'gestión de la posición editada' log via /api/logs/export) and PUT /api/positions/{id}/levels (move SL+TP persist + 'niveles movidos a mano' log, SL-only unchanged TP, invalid SL above price long→400, invalid TP below price long→400, 404 unknown/invalid id, breakeven flag check skipped because entry≈current price so flag path couldn't be exercised reliably — covered implicitly by the (price-sl)*d check in position_levels). Frontend verified against the preview URL on Bybit with a paper ETHUSDT long position opened via /api/manual-order and cleaned up at the end. (B) PositionRulesDialog: position-rules-{id} opens position-rules-dialog with every expected testid (position-rules-breakeven-toggle, be-r, trailing-toggle, trail-r, trail-atr, partial-toggle, partial-r, partial-pct, ai-review-toggle, save, cancel); initial values match GET /api/settings exactly (be_start_r=1, trail_start_r=1.5, trail_atr_mult=1, partial_tp_r=1.5, partial_tp_pct=50; breakeven/trailing/partial toggles ON; ai_review OFF). Out-of-range be_r=5 shows position-rules-error and disables Guardar. Enabling ai_review reveals position-rules-ai-review-minutes. Save → toast success, button shows 'Gestión ●' with sky border/text (highlight ok). (A) Chart drag: position-chart-{id} opens position-chart-dialog with level-handle-sl and level-handle-tp (+ their -price labels showing 1,664.72 and 1,766.62 initially). Dragging SL down ~40px updated level-handle-sl-price to 1,635.21 WITHOUT sending anything; level-confirm-bar appears with apply+cancel; Cancel removes the bar. Dragging TP up then Apply → PUT /api/positions/{id}/levels, toast success, header shows new TP. Invalid drag (SL above current price on a long) → Apply shows toast 'Niveles inválidos para el precio actual (1697.89): el SL debe quedar por debajo y el TP al otro lado' (HTTP 400) and handle returns to the stored level. Main dashboard chart does NOT render level-handle-* (confirmed). (C) Manual order dialog toggles: flipped settings via PUT /api/settings (breakeven_enabled=false, trailing_enabled=true, partial_tp_enabled=false, be/trail/partial R=2, partial_pct=60), reloaded, opened manual-order-dialog from chart-buy-btn; manual-order-breakeven-toggle=false, manual-order-trailing-toggle=true, manual-order-partial-toggle=false, manual-order-ai-review-toggle=false (default), manual-order-trail-r=2, manual-order-trail-atr=2; manual-order-be-r / partial-r / partial-pct not rendered while their toggles are OFF (correct). Original settings restored. Mobile 390px: positions-cards present with 1 rules+chart+close button per position card; scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal overflow). FX (/hotforex, /pepperstone): skipped on the UI as documented env limitation (Yahoo Finance paused in preview, same shared code path exercised by Bybit). Paper ETHUSDT position opened for the UI flow was closed. Bot settings verified unchanged.

issues: Pre-existing non-blocking React dev warning: <option> cannot be a child of <span> (Emergent instrumentation wraps native options in a <span>). Same warning as iter115 — harmless at runtime, pollutes the dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: shared_routes.position_levels: when body.sl/tp are None it falls back to p.sl/p.tp (good). However the 'inválidos' check uses `price` which can be p.mark_price when the ticker has no live entry — fine in paper, but in REAL this may misvalidate during stream gaps; consider refreshing the ticker before the check.
PositionRulesDialog shows position-rules-ai-review-minutes only when ai_review toggle is ON; initial value is ai_review_minutes || 15 (not persisted as 15 unless user saves), matches the spec.
LevelHandles polls every 120 ms (setInterval tick) just to recompute priceToCoordinate on zoom/scroll — correct but mildly wasteful; a resize-observer on the price scale would be lighter.
seed_data_creation: Paper ETHUSDT long opened via /api/manual-order for UI and backend tests; closed within each test and at end of browser flow. Global settings snapshot captured and restored after the (C) flip. No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter116 verified. Backend endpoints: PUT /api/positions/{id}/levels (body {sl?,tp?}) validates against engine.market.tickers[symbol].price||mark_price; sets breakeven=true when SL has crossed entry in favour; logs 'niveles movidos a mano'. PUT /api/positions/{id}/rules (TradeRules body) stores {rules: TradeRules.rules() or None, ai_review_minutes}; empty body clears both; logs 'gestión de la posición editada'. Both endpoints are 404 on invalid/unknown id, 400 on exit_mode='cross'. Frontend: PositionRulesDialog (testids prefix 'position-rules'), LevelHandles (level-handle-sl/tp with -price children + level-confirm-bar / -apply / -cancel). TradeRulesFields is shared by both ManualOrderDialog (prefix 'manual-order') and PositionRulesDialog (prefix 'position-rules') via rulesState/rulesValid/rulesBody. The /api/logs/export endpoint (hours=24|48|72, fmt=txt|csv) is the reliable way to assert log lines in parallel-test environments (the /api/dashboard logs list is capped at 100 and can lose lines under heavy parallel noise). Yahoo Finance remains paused in preview → FX UI paths cannot be exercised directly; same shared code path verified on Bybit.
